nodes.label: Chrono_ros library target
nodes.rationale: Forced to C++17 (required by ROS Humble) and forced SHARED. Contains the Chrono-side half of every handler plus the IPC layer, but deliberately no ROS publishing code.

nodes.label: chrono_ros_node subprocess executable
nodes.rationale: The ROS-side process. The IPC sources (ChROSSharedMemory, ChROSRingBuffer, ChROSIPCChannel) and all *_ros.cpp publishing implementations are compiled directly into it via target_sources rather than linked from Chrono_ros, explicitly to avoid circular dependencies. Installed to lib on Linux (internal helper, keeps bin/ clean and simplifies RPATH) but to bin on Windows where DLL PATH resolution requires it.

nodes.label: FastDDS imported-target IMPORTED_GLOBAL promotion
nodes.rationale: FastDDS pulls in fastcdr/fastrtps/foonathan_memory as imported targets scoped to this directory. They are promoted to IMPORTED_GLOBAL (skipping ones SynChrono already promoted) so downstream consumers such as the Python SWIG ros module can evaluate generator expressions against them - a workaround for Fast-CDR issue #251.
